sources.semantics: Historical SDK stdio gateway: exports five upstream names, release tool and createGateway. Reads checkout MCP configuration unless connector injected; memoizes lazy client promises, drops failed connects, passes inherited environment and offline preference, discards stderr. Catalog paginates serially with 20-second timeouts, rejects repeated cursors and duplicate names, namespaces upstream names and caches route map. Augments doctor schema and adds release. Calls serialize through a promise queue (rejection does not poison next call); browser ownership inferred from upstream or Browser-prefixed description; competing modes return error. Call timeout 180 seconds. Successful attach/detach toggles debugger guard; release refuses while attached, closes owner and deletes client; explicit browser_close clears owner. Supplied doctor names bypass upstream and invoke adapter. close allSettled closes clients and clears ownership; signal/stdin shutdown closes gateway/server. Warms all catalogs before advertising stdio. Limits: catalog caching, heuristic ownership, upstream failure after acquisition can retain owner, no proof of live host attachment or successful browser execution.
